summary: Option widget supports three types: bool (toggle), int (bounded/unbounded numeric), list (enumeration with display names)
List type getValue returns possibleValues[i][1] (the key); getDisplayValue returns possibleValues[i][2] (display name) or key if no display name
optVisible uses visibleCheckFn callback to conditionally hide options; enables format-conditional visibility
Bool leftKey and rightKey both toggle value identically; no directional behavior for booleans
